title: The US is advancing AI safety through state and federal action
summary: OpenAI outlines a “reverse federalism” approach to AI governance, where state laws help build a national framework for safe, democratic AI.
body: OpenAI outlines a “reverse federalism” approach to AI governance, where state laws help build a national framework for safe, democratic AI.
summaryZh: OpenAI阐述了其推进AI安全治理的“反向联邦制”方法，探讨如何通过州级立法来协助构建全国统一、民主的AI安全监管框架。原始信息显示：OpenAI outlines a “reverse federalism” approach to AI governance, where state laws help build a national framework for safe, democratic AI.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“The US is advancing AI safety through state and federal action”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI阐述了其关于美国州级与联邦AI治理的政策立场，涉及大模型安全合规的监管框架。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
